purpose: EmbeddingProvider qualification for P1 (Cross-Question Deep Research) dense semantic geometry over Chinese public-Zhihu-like text.

provenance.note: All sentences were handcrafted for this battery. They are P1-*shaped* (Chinese opinion / technical discussion phrasing typical of public Zhihu answers) but are NOT real Zhihu content and NOT derived from any captured corpus. Safe to send to a remote embedding provider under the P1-T01 fixture-only egress rule.

scope_caveat: This is a small handcrafted discrimination battery, NOT a universal Chinese embedding benchmark and NOT a Gold set. It establishes provider/model-scoped directional evidence only. Sampled evidence must not be upgraded to a global quality claim.

acceptance_criteria.AC_1_relevance: For each relevance anchor: cos(related) > cos(unrelated), margin >= 0.10.
acceptance_criteria.AC_2_near_duplicate_vs_novel: For each novelty anchor: cos(near_duplicate) > cos(same_topic_novel).
acceptance_criteria.AC_3_terminology_variation: For each terminology pair: cos(variant) > cos(unrelated_control).
acceptance_criteria.AC_4_paraphrase_above_opposing: min(cos over paraphrase pairs) > max(cos over opposing-framing pairs). METHODOLOGICAL CAVEAT (recorded, not retro-fitted): this formulation compares pairs drawn from DIFFERENT topics, and cosine similarity is not calibrated across topics, so it conflates topical baseline with semantic relation. It is reported for completeness but is NOT treated as decision-decisive. See AC_4b.
acceptance_criteria.AC_4b_opposing_within_anchor: DECISION-RELEVANT FORM OF AC_4. For each within-anchor item: cos(anchor, paraphrase) > cos(anchor, opposing). Holds topical baseline constant, so it isolates the semantic relation. This is the criterion that governs whether novelty / redundancy control can distinguish an opposing viewpoint from a duplicate.
acceptance_criteria.AC_5_short_query_to_long_passage: For each short query, the on-topic long passage ranks above the off-topic long passage.
acceptance_criteria.AC_6_determinism: Re-embedding the same input yields vectors equal within 1e-6 absolute tolerance.
acceptance_criteria.AC_7_malformed_input: Empty / whitespace / oversize inputs produce a deterministic, documented outcome (valid vector OR machine-readable failure identity). Never a silent garbage vector.
acceptance_criteria.AC_8_vector_contract: Fixed dimension across inputs and batch sizes; all components finite; L2 norm within 1e-3 of the declared normalization profile target.
acceptance_criteria.AC_9_identity: Provider echoes or deterministically exposes a stable model identity usable as cache-key identity.
acceptance_criteria.AC_10_failure_identity: Unknown model name and unreachable endpoint each produce a machine-readable failure identity (not a silent empty result).
acceptance_criteria.AC_11_no_egress_at_embed_time: The battery completes successfully with a black-hole proxy configured, proving no outbound network call is required at embed time.

I_opposing_within_anchor.description: WITHIN-ANCHOR opposing-vs-paraphrase discrimination. For each anchor, a same-topic paraphrase and a same-topic opposing restatement are compared against THE SAME anchor. This is the decision-relevant formulation for novelty / redundancy control: an opposing claim must be scored LESS similar to the anchor than a true paraphrase, otherwise redundancy control would discard a genuinely different viewpoint as a duplicate. Unlike AC_4 (which compares across different topics), this comparison holds topical baseline constant.

items.query: 注意力机制的计算复杂度
items.on_topic: 自注意力的核心开销在于对每个位置都要与序列中所有其他位置计算一次相关性，因此计算量随序列长度呈平方增长，显存占用也同步上升。为了缓解这个问题，工程上常见做法包括稀疏注意力、滑窗注意力以及线性化近似，但它们通常要在长程依赖建模能力上做出一定取舍。
items.off_topic: 选购一台家用烤箱时，主要应该关注温控精度、内胆材质与热风循环是否均匀这三点。温控不准会导致烘焙失败，内胆材质影响清洁难度，而热风循环是否均匀则直接决定上色是否一致。
